questions.prompt: Which article of the Code of Conduct begins: "I am an American, fighting in the forces which guard my country and our way of life."?
questions.explanation: First Article: I am an American, fighting in the forces which guard my country and our way of life. I am prepared to give my life in their defense.

questions.prompt: Which article of the Code of Conduct begins: "I will never surrender of my own free will."?
questions.explanation: Second Article: I will never surrender of my own free will. If in command, I will never surrender the members of my command while they still have the means to resist.

questions.prompt: Which article of the Code of Conduct begins: "If I am captured, I will continue to resist by all means available."?
questions.explanation: Third Article: If I am captured, I will continue to resist by all means available. I will make every effort to escape and aid others to escape. I will accept neither parole nor special favors from the enemy.

questions.prompt: Complete Article I: "I am an American, fighting in the forces which guard my country and our way of life. I am prepared ..."

questions.explanation: Article I: I am an American, fighting in the forces which guard my country and our way of life. I am prepared to give my life in their defense.

questions.prompt: Complete Article II: "I will never surrender of my own free will. If in command, I will never surrender the members of my command ..."

questions.explanation: Article II: I will never surrender of my own free will. If in command, I will never surrender the members of my command while they still have the means to resist.
